```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open("content/customer_survey.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

hero = data.get("hero", {})
survey = data.get("survey", {})
fine = data.get("fine_print", {})

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value if value is not None else ""), quote=True)

def safe_url(value):
    url = str(value or "").strip()

    if url.startswith(("https://", "http://")):
        return safe(url)

    if url.startswith(("/", "//")):
        return "#"

    if url.lower().endswith(".qmd"):
        url = url[:-4] + ".html"

    return safe(url)

def paragraphs(value):
    return "".join(
        f"<p>{safe(part.strip())}</p>"
        for part in str(value or "").split("\n\n")
        if part.strip()
    )

sections_html = ""

for section in fine.get("sections", []):
    sections_html += f"""
    <div class="cw-survey-info-block">
      <h3>{safe(section.get("title"))}</h3>
      {paragraphs(section.get("text"))}
    </div>
    """

contact_info = safe(fine.get("contact_information", ""))

html = f"""
<div class="cw-survey">

  <section class="cw-survey-hero">
    <div class="cw-survey-hero-content">

      <span class="cw-survey-eyebrow">
        {safe(hero.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h1>{safe(hero.get("title"))}</h1>

      <p>{safe(hero.get("description"))}</p>

    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="cw-survey-main">

    <div class="cw-survey-main-content">

      <span class="cw-survey-section-label">
        {safe(survey.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(survey.get("title"))}</h2>

      <h3 class="cw-survey-welcome">
        {safe(survey.get("welcome"))}
      </h3>

      {paragraphs(survey.get("description"))}

      <div class="cw-survey-action">
        <a
          href="{safe_url(survey.get("button_url"))}"
          class="cw-survey-button"
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer"
        >
          {safe(survey.get("button_label"))}
          <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
        </a>

        <span class="cw-survey-action-note">
          Opens in a new tab
        </span>
      </div>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-survey-contact">
      <div class="cw-survey-contact-icon"
           aria-hidden="true">?</div>

      <div>
        <h3>Have a specific question?</h3>
        <p>{safe(survey.get("note"))}</p>

        <a href="{safe_url(survey.get("contact_url"))}">
          {safe(survey.get("contact_label"))} →
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>

  </section>

  <section class="cw-survey-details">

    <div class="cw-survey-details-heading">

      <span class="cw-survey-section-label">
        {safe(fine.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(fine.get("title"))}</h2>

      <p>{safe(fine.get("introduction"))}</p>

    </div>

    <details class="cw-survey-disclosure">

      <summary>
        <span>Read survey information and fine print</span>
        <span class="cw-survey-plus"
              aria-hidden="true">+</span>
      </summary>

      <div class="cw-survey-disclosure-body">

        {sections_html}

        <div class="cw-survey-info-block">
          <h3>Burden Estimate Contact</h3>
          <p class="cw-survey-address">
            {contact_info}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="cw-survey-info-block">
          <h3>Paperwork Reduction Act</h3>
          {paragraphs(fine.get("paperwork_notice"))}
        </div>

        <div class="cw-survey-omb">
          <strong>{safe(fine.get("omb_label"))}</strong>
          <span>
            OMB Control Number:
            {safe(fine.get("omb_number"))}
          </span>
          <span>
            Expiration:
            {safe(fine.get("omb_expiration"))}
          </span>
        </div>

      </div>

    </details>

  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
